decisions.replacement_answer: In a Poisson counting regime, independent detected photoelectrons produce one-sided shot-current PSD S_I = 2 q I in A^2/Hz and RMS current sqrt(2 q I Delta_f) in a matched noise band. This counting uncertainty contributes to radiometric measurement uncertainty. Poisson photon arrivals are an approximation: thermal radiation can also exhibit photon bunching, and source excess noise, dark current and readout noise can matter. State the source statistics, optical bandwidth, detector response and measurement bandwidth before identifying a fundamental sensitivity limit.
